 MICHIGAN — As Medicare Open Enrollment continues, Michiganders are being reminded that professional assistance is available at no cost to help them review their coverage options and make informed decisions.
 Medicare specialists like Debbie Stroup from M1 Insurance Group can help compare available plans, explain coverage differences, and identify options that best fit their healthcare needs and budgets.
 “We all have a license through the federal government, through Medicare to help you do this,” said Stroup. “We look at all plans that are available to you, not just the plan that you're on, but all plans. If you're like me, I love a good bargain, but I don't want to just get what's cheap. I want to get what's best for me.”
 Medicare Open Enrollment is going on now through December 7. Plans then start on January 1, 2027. 
 Those seeking assistance with Medicare enrollment or plan comparisons can contact Debbie Stroup with M1 Insurance Group at 888-260-8922 or visit m1insurancegroup.com for more information.
